scope: One local saved edition; all cited full headlines in final PDF ledger, all nine headings, and every spec parts-body plus retail intro compared with extracted PDF and HTML. Existing desktop/mobile execution receipts are hash-bound and inspected; no browser render rerun.
normalization: Unicode NFKC, invisible soft-hyphen/zero-width removal, CJK-to-CJK line-wrap whitespace joining, ordered Unicode word/numeral tokens and whitespace folding. Citation-number chips and exact repeated PDF footer removed for paragraph matching; no fuzzy or partial-text exceptions. Typography/punctuation differences are outside this text-completeness check.
limits: Full paragraph matching verifies every textual word/numeral sequence, not identical punctuation, visual glyph shape or economic meaning.
PDF page geometry is represented by the builder layout receipt; visual styling is separately reviewed.
